title: DT-TEO canonical message
description: The one message shape every service after the ingestion gateway receives. One message = one reading of one point. Meaning (what the point is, what it belongs to) lives in the asset model, linked by `point`.

v.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes so old and new messages can be told apart.

point.description: Point ID. Must match a ref:hasTimeseriesId in the asset model (dtteo_asset_model.ttl). Lowercase, dot-separated: <equipment>.<point>.

value.description: The reading after normalisation. Numbers for measurements and percentages, strings for modes/states, booleans for on/off.

unit.description: QUDT unit ID, the same one used by brick:hasUnit in the asset model (e.g. DEG_C, KiloW, PERCENT). null for values with no unit, such as a mode.

sensor_time.description: When the reading was measured (event time), in UTC. If the source gives no time, the adapter uses the time it read the value.

ingest_time.description: When the ingestion gateway received the reading (processing time), in UTC. Always set by the gateway, never by the device.

quality.description: Set by the validator. GOOD = passed all checks. SUSPECT = usable but flagged (e.g. outside the usual range). BAD = failed a check; stored for the record but not used by the twin.

source.description: Optional. Where the reading came from, as <adapter>:<device id>. Used for tracing problems back to a device.
